newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-SASURU SHOWS HIS CLASS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SASURU SHOWS HIS CLASS.

text.p: Trainer Geoff Wragg's highly regarded Sasuru extended his winning run to five by completing a British one-two in the Group One Prix d'Ispahan at Longchamp on Sunday.
The favourite was initially held up in third place by jockey Michael Hills as Tamayaz and Wixim, the two other British-based runners, set the pace.

Wixim proved to be the main challenger, but Sasuru gained the upper hand in the last 50 yards and ran on well to beat Wixim by a short neck, with Simon du Desert taking third place, three lengths further back.
Wragg said: "This is an improving horse that seems to get better with every race. He may eventually even stay a mile and a half.
"He is entered in the Arc de Triomphe, but our immediate concern is Royal Ascot. He will either go for the Prince of Wales's Stakes or the Hardwicke Stakes."
Roger Charlton, Wixim's trainer, said: "He ran well but the trip basically is a bit too far for him. He will revert to a mile and head to Royal Ascot for the Queen Anne Stakes."
